key_findings: System tools (24 builtin): 14,400-17,600 tokens - mandatory, fixed cost
MCP tools: 385 (SQLite) to 125,964 (Docker) tokens - wildly variable, Tool Search reduces by 85%
Skill loading: contested (61 tokens frontmatter vs 50k+ observed) - requires validation
Command files: zero baseline, 500-1,500 tokens on first invoke, 2-3 tokens cached
Tool results: silent accumulator, 50-100k tokens per hour of active dev work
